nodes.text: Women and children fainted after being caught in the crowd during the 'Thavaikka' event stampede in Madurai.

Three women and four children fainted in Thirupparankundram temple queue during crowded Vaikasi Visakam celebrations amid high temperatures. 31 people, including women and children, are feared dead after a stampede broke out during Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) chief Vijay's campaign ... 31 people, including women and children, are feared dead after a stampede broke out during Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) chief Vijay's campaign ...
